headline: GTA 6 countdown: 6 days to go
title: GTA 6 Countdown 6 Days Left | 475 million | Vice City Is Back
video_script: Only 6 days until GTA 6. The second trailer set a record with 475 million views across all platforms in 24 hours. Grand Theft Auto 6 comes out on 19 November 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S. Are you playing it on day one? Comment below!
joke: That is a lot of people pausing on every single frame.
description: GTA 6 countdown - 6 days to go. The second trailer set a record with 475 million views across all platforms in 24 hours. Grand Theft Auto VI launches on 19 November 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Facts from Rockstar's announcements as summarised on Wikipedia.
